GLib security backport for GitCraft

Base: the published crates.io glib 0.18.5 release, including its MIT license.
Archive SHA-256: 233daaf6e83ae6a12a52055f568f9d7cf4671dabb78ff9560ab6da230ce00ee5
Archive: https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/glib/0.18.5/download

Security fix: RUSTSEC-2024-0429 / GHSA-wrw7-89jp-8q8g
Upstream patch: https://github.com/gtk-rs/gtk-rs-core/pull/1343
Change: src/variant_iter.rs, VariantStrIter::impl_get declares its out-pointer
mutable and passes &mut p to g_variant_get_child instead of &p. No API changes.
Additional analyzer clarification: src/auto/date_time.rs calls DateTime::hash(self)
explicitly when hashing its u32 GLib hash value. This disambiguates the inherent
method from the Hash trait method without changing runtime behavior.
The remaining release files are unchanged.

Reason for the backport: as reviewed on 2026-11-14, the latest stable Tauri
2.12.5 still requires gtk ^0.18, which requires glib ^0.18. The newest compatible
released glib is 0.18.5. Fixed releases start at 0.20.0; the newest stable glib
is 0.22.10, but adding it directly would not replace the vulnerable transitive
0.18 instance. No prerelease framework or advisory-ignore rule is used.

Validation: the Linux release job runs glib_variant_string_iterator, covering
next, next_back, nth, nth_back, last and mixed-direction iteration with the
optimized glib dependency. Windows does not compile this Linux dependency.

Remove this Cargo patch and vendor directory when the stable Tauri/GTK chain
can resolve a released, fixed glib. Then use the newest compatible stable
release and rerun the Linux regression test. Version-only advisory scanners
may continue to flag 0.18.5; do not treat their absence as proof of this patch.
